quickAdd.label: Quick add
quickAdd.help: Type a title and an optional length (3:00, 1:05:00, 5m, 90s), then press Enter. Start with # to add a header. A time-like ending is read as the length, so add a length at the end, e.g. "John 3:16 5:00", to keep a reference in the title.

errors.titleRequired: Add a title before the length.
errors.lengthRange: The length can be at most 10 hours.

clearOrder.title: Clear the order?
clearOrder.body_one: This removes {{count}} item from “{{title}}”, together with its notes, comments and file links. This cannot be undone.
clearOrder.body_other: This removes all {{count}} items from “{{title}}”, together with their notes, comments and file links. This cannot be undone.
